create_expr_cast: create an expression that casts column values to a specified data type with strict or lenient error handling
test_expr_over: test window group-by expressions that compute aggregations partitioned by column values over grouped data
build_expr_rolling: build rolling window computations including min, max, mean, std, sum with configurable window size and centering
refactor_expr_map_batches: refactor to apply a custom Python function to whole Series batches with optional elementwise optimization and return type specification
summarize_expr_filter: summarize filtering expressions that select rows based on boolean predicates within aggregation contexts
